summary: Notification templates (Email, Slack, Webhook and others) are created at /api/v2/notification_templates or in the UI and attached to job templates, organizations or projects at started, success or error triggers, e.g. /api/v2/job_templates/n/notification_templates_error.
questions: How do I get notified when a job fails?
How do I attach a notification template to a job template via API?
What does a Slack notification need?
